title: Multiplayer space shooter custom engine C/Rust, Vulkan and Bullet
author: fluxtah
selftext:
Hey All,

Sharing a short video of gameplay footage of a game I am working on, AI Assisted, procedural graphics on a custom game engine written in C/Rust on the Vulkan API with Bullet physics.

My workflow is basically goal based, working through a list of GitHub issues in milestones, currently on 0.2.0. 

Game is recorded on my Mac Studio though also have a win client, runs at 60 FPS, using codex and got into a workflow with many frame budget tests to divide graphics, audio, Bot AI and physics so when I make changes I can keep it all within budget, supports 24 players, 12 aside.

Thinking about adding tanks and mechs next!

Thanks for watching, feedback welcome!
